# Widget `mock-exam` — Mock exam

**Pack:** core

**When to use:** Use once, in the exam page: a timed quiz drawn from all lecture quizzes.

## Example block

```json
{
  "kind": "widget",
  "type": "mock-exam",
  "title": "Mock exam",
  "props": {
    "questionCount": 20,
    "minutes": 30
  }
}
```

## Props

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `questionCount` | integer (≥ 5, ≤ 60) | no |
| `minutes` | integer (≥ 5, ≤ 180) | no |

The validator also checks the cross-field rules (ids that must exist, lengths that must match,
expressions that must parse). Run `npm run validate` after writing a widget.
